context:
Goal: no blocked turns for text that is not an instruction.
Problem (rule): every echo of a command you ran, and every long paste, needs a hand-written feedback item before the turn can end.
Based on (read): the feedback guard already skips a lone short message, but has no skip for command echoes.
Departs from: main logs every message — option a skips command echoes.
Why yours: it changes what counts as your feedback.

lastAnswer.note: q7 A, and im open to B too if done right

options.how: The feedback guard skips a message that is only the echo of a command you ran.
options.label: Skip command echoes only (recommended)
options.lose: None known; they are your own commands.

options.how: As a, plus one item may cover several messages in a row.
options.label: Also let one item cover a run of messages
options.lose: A ruling inside a run can hide.

why: It changes which of your messages need a written item.
